Free Low Poly Vehicles Pack by Raphael Gonçalves (RGS_Dev)
License: CC0
Author page: https://rgsdev.itch.io/free-low-poly-vehicles-pack
Download source: https://opengameart.org/content/free-low-poly-vehicles-pack
The ZIP is the unmodified original pack, containing 21 individual FBX vehicles plus the combined scene.
GETAWAY uses converted GLB versions of the van, muscle car, sports car, police sedan, taxi, SUV and hatchback.
Geometry is preserved; normalization, material tuning and wheel metadata were added for the browser.
